title: Listening Drill — Printing a proof
description: Practical demonstration. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Printing a proof
sections.transcript:
INSTRUCTOR: This demonstration is about printing a proof copy. Watch the whole process once before trying it yourself. If you start while I'm still talking, you may miss the order of the steps.

INSTRUCTOR: Get the scrap paper ready. Begin by checking the paper guide. When everything is in position, wait two minutes. It may look as though nothing is happening at first.

INSTRUCTOR: Look for clear margins before moving on. keep fingers away from the rollers. Leave yourself time to clear the work area so the next group can start promptly.

questions.instructions: Choose the option that completes the note.
Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER.
